name: How long does ADU foundation construction typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does ADU foundation construction typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for ADU foundation construction can vary based on the foundation type and site complexity. A standard slab-on-grade foundation might take 1-2 weeks, while a more intricate crawl space or raised foundation could extend to 2-4 weeks. Factors such as weather delays, site accessibility, and the need for significant excavation or grading can also influence the timeline. Hometelligent Inc. prioritizes efficient scheduling to keep projects on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU foundation construction typically takes 1-4 weeks, depending on the foundation type and site complexity.
